name: Lava and Void Fishing
description: Fish in lava with the right rod or hook, and in the void below the world.

pages.title: Lava and Void Fishing
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Lava**: use a Netherite or Blazing rod, or a **Lavaproof Hook** on any rod.
- **Void**: fit a **Hook of the Depths**, then cast into the open void of the End.
- Bites come more slowly in both.

**Lava fishing** works in any lava pool. What you catch can't burn. Overworld lava gives ember koi, magma mackerel, obsidian pike and more; the Nether adds witherfin, soulscale and the Blazing Swordfish.\
\
The **Blazing Fishing Rod** catches Nether lava fish anywhere.

Lava junk is obsidian fragments (4 make obsidian) and fish bones (bone meal). Lava crates are **Obsidian Crates**; break them with a diamond pickaxe or better.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** **Witherfin** gives Wither when eaten. Most other lava fish give Fire Resistance.

**Void fishing** needs the bobber below the world's void line: in **The End**, anything below y50, so cast off an island edge. In the Overworld it is y-70 and below, under the bedrock floor.\
\
End void fish include Enderfin (an ender pearl), Endergazer (an eye of ender), Elytrout (phantom membrane) and the legendary **Dragon Fish**.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** The Overworld void has its own fish, Alpha Fish among them. There are none for the Nether void.\
\
The **Voidseeker**, which sends you to your spawn point when eaten, is off in this pack: it would skip every ride home. [#](2E5AAC)[Getting Around](entry://transport/getting_around)[#]().
